links.outcome: Fine-tuned LLM accuracy on external site validation set versus internal test set
links.effect: SFT achieved 97.9% accuracy on the external University of Wisconsin dataset, compared with 97.2% on the held-out test set, so no performance drop at the new site.
links.quote: SFT achieved 97.9% accuracy on external validation dataset.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to detect stigmatizing language in clinical notes
Comparing supervised fine-tuning, in-context learning, and keyword search for stigma detection
Human review of LLM reasoning for false positives

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM approaches (zero-shot, ICL, SFT) for detecting stigmatizing language in retrospective clinical notes, including an external validation set, but tests model performance rather than an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
